title: Delete the dead nullService ternary in sy2_device_restore_idle_blank_test.dart's _buildHarness

evidence.quote: : null, // always null — no service needed for these tests

why: `nullService ? null : null` evaluates to null on both branches — the nullService bool parameter has zero effect on behavior, yet every call site passes `nullService: true` as if it mattered. A future maintainer who needs a non-null-service variant of this harness will reasonably flip it to `nullService: false` expecting different behavior and get nothing, wasting debugging time on a flag that was already inert.
recommendation: Delete the nullService parameter and the ternary; pass deviceRestoreServiceProvider.overrideWithValue(null) directly, matching the comment's own admission of actual behavior.
acceptance_criteria: nullService parameter and the dead ternary are removed from _buildHarness; dart analyze / dart format stay clean.
